messages.content: What is the roster of Manchester United?

function.name: sports_team_get_top_scorer
function.description: Retrieve the top scorer of a sports team in a specific season. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team.description: The name of the sports team.

season.description: The season of interest, e.g. 2020-2021 NBA season.

league.description: The league the team is part of. Default is 'NBA'.

message.content:
I don’t have live access to the current squad list, but here’s a snapshot of the Manchester United first‑team as it stood at the start of the 2023‑24 Premier League season (players who were officially registered with the club at that time):

| Position | Player | Nationality |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| **Goalkeepers** | Dean Henderson | England |
| | David de Gea | Spain *(he left in the summer of 2023, so the squad now only has Henderson)* |
| **Defenders** | Luke Shaw | England |
| | Harry Maguire | England |
| | Raphael Varane | France *(he departed to Real Madrid in the summer of 2023, so the squad now only has Shaw and Maguire)* |
| | Aaron Wan-Bissaka | England |
| | Diogo Dalot | Portugal |
| | Eric Bailly | Ivory Coast |
| | Lisandro Martínez | Argentina |
| **Midfielders** | Bruno Fernandes | Portugal |
| | Marcus Rashford | England |
| | Jadon Sancho | England |
| | Mason Greenwood | England |
| | Antony | Brazil |
| | Paul Pogba | France |
| | Scott McTominay | Scotland |
| | Donny van de Beek | Netherlands |
| | Nuno Mendes | Portugal |
| **Forwards** | Edinson Cavani | Uruguay |
| | Cristiano Ronaldo | Portugal *(he left in the summer of 2023, so the squad now only has Cavani)* |
| | Anthony Martial | France |
| | Jadon Sancho | England |
| | Marcus Rashford | England |
| | Mason Greenwood | England |

> **Note:**  
> * The squad has changed since the 2023‑24 season began – several players have transferred out (e.g., David de Gea, Raphael Varane, Cristiano Ronaldo) and new signings have been added (e.g., Dean Henderson, Lisandro Martínez).  
> * For the most up‑to‑date roster, you can check the official Manchester United website or reputable sports databases such as Transfermarkt or the Premier League’s official site.
